Backend Engineer - API Platform

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Backend Engineer to join our platform team. You will design and maintain production-grade APIs that power our SaaS infrastructure, collaborating with product and infrastructure teams to deliver reliable, scalable services to thousands of users worldwide.

Must-have Requirements
- 3+ years professional experience developing backend services with Python
- Proven track record shipping production APIs to real users
- Strong experience with PostgreSQL database design and optimization
- Hands-on experience with Docker and CI/CD pipeline implementation
- Experience working in fast-paced startup or scale-up environment

Nice-to-have Requirements
- Experience with FastAPI or similar modern Python web frameworks
- Familiarity with Kubernetes orchestration
- Exposure to monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)
- Previous microservices architecture experience
- Contributions to open-source projects

What We Offer
Competitive salary, flexible remote work, professional development budget, and the opportunity to work on systems used by 100,000+ customers across Europe and North America.
